name: valve_raven_fire_trap_cage
note: Ravenholm's cage fire trap (d1_town_01): a narrow yard with a chain-link pen in its corner and a gas burner at the pen's foot, meat hooks hanging from a beam (one with a dead headcrab), a work table with a trap propeller's engine; a valve wheel on a propane tank turns the gas on, a red button on the pen's post (or a shot or blast near it) lights it

trigger.name: zombiecage_1_trap_1_out_rl
trigger.what: gas off, the fire goes out
